d: An anthropomorphic wolf with a muscular build and thick, shaggy platinum white fur covering the body and a long, voluminous tail. The face features sharp, narrow golden-yellow eyes with a focused expression, and the head is topped with a thick mane of spiky platinum white hair adorned with a red ribbon. The outfit consists of a silver metallic chest piece with red accents and green vine wrappings, a green leaf-like waist wrap, and baggy charcoal grey trousers with gold embroidery and red ties at the ankles. Signature details include large, sharp silver metallic claws on the fingers and white paws. BODY COLOR: platinum white
